title.zh: 柴斌 — GPU 性能工程师

site.description: Bin Chai is a senior software engineer at NVIDIA with around five years of full-stack experience spanning algorithms for search, ads and recommendations, business architecture and shared platforms, and GPU performance optimization and acceleration.
site.ogDescription: Around five years of full-stack experience in algorithms for search, ads and recommendations, business architecture and shared platforms, and GPU performance optimization and acceleration.

role.zh: NVIDIA 高级软件开发工程师

lead.en: I have around **five years of full-stack experience**, spanning **algorithms for search, ads and recommendations**, **business architecture and shared platforms**, and **low-level GPU performance optimization and acceleration**. Through my work with major tech companies in China and abroad, I’ve gained extensive experience providing technical support.
lead.zh: 我有 **5 年左右的全栈工作经验**，涵盖**搜广推算法**、**中层业务架构与中台建设**，以及**底层 GPU 性能优化与加速**；同时，我在与国内外大厂的合作中积累了丰富的技术支持经验。

text.en: **GPU Kernel** ([HSTU](https://github.com/pytorch/FBGEMM/tree/main/fbgemm_gpu/experimental/hstu), [DeepSeek Indexer](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/tree/develop/python/cudnn/deepseek_sparse_attention), [GR Decode Attention](https://developer.nvidia.cn/blog/gr-inference-generative-recommendation-inference-system-design-performance-evaluation/), [OneRec-customized FA2](https://github.com/cb521/flash-attention/tree/bwd_loop_opt), etc.): kernel development and tuning with CUDA, CUTLASS and CuTe DSL.
text.zh: **GPU Kernel**（[HSTU](https://github.com/pytorch/FBGEMM/tree/main/fbgemm_gpu/experimental/hstu)、[DeepSeek Indexer](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/tree/develop/python/cudnn/deepseek_sparse_attention)、[GR Decode Attention](https://developer.nvidia.cn/blog/gr-inference-generative-recommendation-inference-system-design-performance-evaluation/)、[OneRec-定制 FA2](https://github.com/cb521/flash-attention/tree/bwd_loop_opt)、etc.）：基于 CUDA、CUTLASS 与 CuTe DSL 的算子开发与调优。

text.en: **GPU Frameworks** ([GR-Inference](https://developer.nvidia.cn/blog/gr-inference-generative-recommendation-inference-system-design-performance-evaluation/), [GPU ANN search](https://segmentfault.com/a/1190000045491973), [cuDF-Spark](https://github.com/cb521/cudf-spark), [Mega-Flink](https://github.com/cb521/Mega-Flink)): generative recommendation inference, GPU retrieval, and batch and stream processing acceleration.
text.zh: **GPU 框架**（[GR-Inference](https://developer.nvidia.cn/blog/gr-inference-generative-recommendation-inference-system-design-performance-evaluation/)、[GPU ANN 检索](https://segmentfault.com/a/1190000045491973)、[cuDF-Spark](https://github.com/cb521/cudf-spark)、[Mega-Flink](https://github.com/cb521/Mega-Flink)）：生成式推荐推理、GPU 检索及批流数据处理加速。

text.en: **Machine Learning Platforms** (Hulu data and features, model training and serving): helped build an ML platform from the ground up for Disney Sports and ESPN personalization.
text.zh: **机器学习平台**（Hulu 数据与特征、模型训练与服务）：参与平台从 0 到 1 建设，支撑 Disney Sports、ESPN 个性化推荐。

text.en: **Search, Ads and Recommendation Algorithms** (cross-domain ICF, UCF / Lookalike recall, cold start and traffic allocation): recommendation development and online experiments for Baidu Feed.
text.zh: **搜广推算法**（跨域 ICF 召回、UCF / Lookalike 召回、冷启动与流量分发）：百度信息流推荐策略研发与线上实验。

meta.zh: 高级软件开发工程师 · DevTech · 2023.08—至今

title.zh: GR-Inference · 生成式召回推理引擎

description.en: Developed a wide-beam generative retrieval engine, optimizing scheduling, KV sharing and attention kernels for deployment in Xiaohongshu Search.
description.zh: 研发面向大 Beam 生成式召回的推理引擎，优化调度、KV 共享与专用 Attention，支撑小红书搜索上线。

results.en: Delivered 1.50–2.53× the throughput of tested SGLang implementations (Qwen3-0.6B BF16, beam 900, full-vocabulary logprob, mean end-to-end latency ≤100 ms).
results.zh: 吞吐达到所测 SGLang 实现的 1.50–2.53 倍（Qwen3-0.6B BF16、Beam=900、全词表 logprob、平均端到端延迟 ≤100 ms）。

results.en: Joint rollout: CTR +0.03 percentage points and offline Recall@1000 +5.7%.
results.zh: 联合上线项目：点击率 +0.03 个百分点，离线 Recall@1000 +5.7%。

description.en: Contributed HSTU kernel implementations and optimizations in FBGEMM for A100, L20, H100, H20 and other NVIDIA GPUs.
description.zh: 参与 FBGEMM 中 HSTU 算子的多卡型实现与优化，覆盖 A100、L20、H100、H20 等 GPU。

results.en: Delivered industry-leading performance near the hardware speed-of-light (SOL) limit across supported GPU architectures.
results.zh: 各卡型实现均达到业界 SOL 性能水平。

results.en: Deployed in feed, e-commerce recommendation and advertising workloads.
results.zh: 相关工作落地信息流、电商推荐与广告场景。

description.en: Contributed CuTe DSL kernels for DeepSeek Indexer, optimizing index computation for sparse attention.
description.zh: 参与 DeepSeek Indexer 算子开发与性能优化，基于 CuTe DSL 实现稀疏注意力索引计算。

results.en: Named as a co-developer in the official cuDNN README.
results.zh: cuDNN 官方 README 列为共同开发者。

description.en: Optimized customized FlashAttention-2 backward kernels with CUTLASS and profiled the distributed training path for Kuaishou's production generative recommender.
description.zh: 结合客户定制化参数，使用 CUTLASS 优化 FlashAttention-2 反向 Kernel，并完成分布式训练链路分析与优化。

results.en: Supported the phase-one production rollout.
results.zh: 支持 OneRec 一期上线。

results.en: Presented the work at GTC San Jose 2026.
results.zh: 作为讲者在 GTC San Jose 2026 分享。

title.zh: GPU 原生 ANN 检索

description.en: Partnered with Baidu Search to evaluate and integrate RAFT IVF-Flat, IVF-PQ, and CAGRA, including INT8 pre-quantization.
description.zh: 与百度搜索合作接入并测试 RAFT IVF-Flat、IVF-PQ、CAGRA，并完成 INT8 低精度方案验证。

results.en: Deployed in a core high-throughput search scenario.
results.zh: 在百度核心高吞吐搜索场景上线。

results.en: Delivered material performance and infrastructure savings.
results.zh: 取得显著性能与资源成本收益。

summary.en: Developed GPU feature-processing plugins for Spark batch jobs and Flink streams, merged into [NVIDIA/recsys-examples](https://github.com/NVIDIA/recsys-examples/pull/540).
summary.zh: 为 Spark 批处理和 Flink 流处理开发 GPU 特征计算插件，已合入 [NVIDIA/recsys-examples](https://github.com/NVIDIA/recsys-examples/pull/540)。

title.en: AI search agents · End-to-end RL post-training optimization
title.zh: AI 搜索智能体 · RL 后训练端到端优化

description.en: Identified redundant computation during RL training and synchronization stalls during generation for XHS, proposed fixes for both, and developed a decode megakernel prototype that reduced sparse indexing kernel time by about 42%.
description.zh: 定位 XHS 客户在 RL 训练中的重复计算和生成阶段的同步等待，提出对应优化方案，并开发解码 Megakernel 原型，将稀疏索引算子耗时缩短约 42%。

results.en: Benchmarked decode megakernels for attention, sparse indexing and MoE.
results.zh: 另实测注意力、稀疏索引和 MoE 解码 megakernel。

label.en: Open-source components for slime and verl

meta.zh: 高级软件开发工程师 · Data · 2022.08—2023.08

title.zh: 机器学习平台与推荐服务

description.en: Helped build an internal ML platform for Disney Sports and ESPN. It gave data scientists tools to produce and extract features and run a recommendation model for email and push notifications.
description.zh: 参与从零搭建 Disney Sports 和 ESPN 的机器学习平台，让数据科学团队能生产和提取特征，并用推荐模型为邮件和消息推送筛选内容。

results.en: Researched features for Sports Data Mart, contributed to warehouse schema design, and developed and tested Spark ETL jobs that produced recommendation features for data scientists.
results.zh: 在 Sports Data Mart 参与特征调研和数仓设计，开发、测试 Spark ETL 作业，为数据科学团队产出推荐特征。

results.en: Developed Lambda services and Python SDK components for Vulcan and refactored its EMR jobs to support feature extraction and model management.
results.zh: 在 Vulcan 开发服务端 Lambda 和客户端 Python SDK 子模块，重构 EMR 作业，支持特征抽取和模型管理。

results.en: Deployed Aegis on Databricks and automated daily inference for the production recommendation model. The platform powered personalized email and push notifications for over 20 million North American sports users.
results.zh: 在 Databricks 上部署 Aegis 模型服务，让推荐模型每日自动推理。平台上线后覆盖超过 2,000 万北美体育用户，为邮件推荐和消息推送提供结果。

results.en: Built an Aperture prototype on Databricks and AWS Chalice to train, store and deploy models.
results.zh: 用 Databricks 和 AWS Chalice 搭建 Aperture 原型，验证模型训练、存储和部署流程。

meta.en: Algorithm Engineer, Search, Ads and Recommendations · Feed · Jul 2021—Aug 2022
meta.zh: 搜广推算法工程师 · Feed · 2021.07—2022.08

description.en: Combined author–follower relationships from Toutiao and Baidu's mobile feed into one graph. Used DeepWalk embeddings to build an item-based collaborative filtering (ICF) lookup that connected authors with potential followers.
description.zh: 把头条和手机百度 Feed 的作者、粉丝关注关系合成一张图，用 DeepWalk 学习图向量并构建 ICF 召回词典，为作者找到可能感兴趣的用户。

results.en: Feed daily active users increased by 0.05% and total media time by 0.17%. Both relative gains were statistically significant.
results.zh: Feed 日活用户数相对提升 0.05%，总媒体时长相对提升 0.17%，两项提升均显著。

results.en: Provided operations and product teams with cases for onboarding new authors.
results.zh: 为运营和产品团队引入新作者提供案例支持。

description.en: Used Swing to identify creators in similar interest areas. Stored similar-user relationships in SNDB and indexed historical clicks. Combined creator votes, Lookalike audiences and author-based recall to select candidates for cold-start distribution.
description.zh: 用 Swing 挖掘兴趣领域相近的 KOL，在 SNDB 中存储相似用户关系，并为历史点击建立索引。冷启动分发时，结合 KOL 投票、Lookalike 人群和作者召回筛选候选。

results.en: Cold-start success rates rose by 2.46%, 14.74% and 2.96% across three content types (relative gains).
results.zh: 三类内容的冷启动成功率分别相对提升 2.46%、14.74% 和 2.96%。

results.en: Adding Lookalike recall to the guaranteed-distribution queue raised media time by 0.33% and distribution volume by 0.35%. Its overall completion rate rose from 28.8% to 31.7%.
results.zh: 在保量队列引入 Lookalike 召回后，媒体时长提升 0.33%，分发量提升 0.35%，整体完成率从 28.8% 提升到 31.7%。

description.en: Worked on the feed's staged distribution of new content, from initial cold-start traffic through wider distribution and promotion. Refactored the online recall service that supplied candidates to these stages.
description.zh: 参与建设新内容的流量阶梯，从冷启动试探、预热扩散到全面分发和推爆，并重构支撑分发的在线召回服务。

results.en: Consolidated three content-specific recall queues into a single request path, saving 40 production machines.
results.zh: 将图短小三路召回队列合并为一次请求，节省 40 台线上机器。

results.en: A related acquisition-queue refactor saved 10 additional machines and improved operations case triage.
results.zh: 重构采买队列，额外节省 10 台机器，也方便运营团队排查分发问题。

results.en: Selected as a Baidu quarterly best project and nominated for the company's top annual award.
results.zh: 项目入选百度季度最佳，并获百度年度最高奖提名。

description.en: Internships at ByteDance, NetEase Cloud Music, Microsoft Engineering, and Tencent.
description.zh: 曾在字节跳动、网易云音乐、微软工程院与腾讯实习。
